title: Food macro — espresso pour into a glass cup
useCase: Cafe brand content, recipe reels, packaging teaser

anchor.subject: A double espresso pouring from a bottomless portafilter into a clear glass cup
anchor.scene: Dark walnut counter, brushed steel machine in soft focus behind, morning light from a window
anchor.motion: Two streams merge into one, crema blooms and swirls, a drop of condensation slides down the glass
anchor.camera: Macro close-up at cup level, locked-off with a slow 5 percent push in
anchor.audio: Espresso trickle, machine hiss, ceramic clink at the end
anchor.light: Soft window backlight from behind the cup, rim on the crema

seedance-2.0.prompt: A double espresso pours from a bottomless portafilter into a clear glass cup standing on a dark walnut counter. Two thin streams leave the basket and merge into one before hitting the surface, where crema blooms outward in slow spirals. A single condensation droplet slides down the outside of the glass. Behind, a brushed steel espresso machine sits in soft focus. Warm morning window light comes from behind the cup, rimming the crema and leaving the front face in gentle shadow. Macro close-up at cup level, locked-off camera with a slow five percent push in, no pan. Warm filmic color grade, photorealistic liquid detail, shallow depth of field. No text, no watermark, no logos, no steam that turns into smoke.
seedance-2.0.notes: Specify the flow direction and merge point; otherwise Seedance invents a chaotic splash.

kling-3.0.prompt:

Characters: A clear glass cup with espresso forming, a bottomless portafilter above it, no hands in frame.
Action: Two thin espresso streams leave the basket and merge into one, hitting the surface where crema blooms in slow spirals; one condensation droplet slides down the outside of the glass.
Camera: Macro close-up at cup level, locked-off tripod, slow five percent push in.
Audio & Style: Espresso trickle, machine hiss, a ceramic clink at the end. Warm filmic grade, shallow depth of field, photorealistic liquid.
Negative: no text, no watermark, no logos, no splash, no steam turning into smoke, no extra cups.
kling-3.0.notes: Kling holds liquid continuity better when the merge is described as a single event.

hailuo-02.prompt: Two thin espresso streams leave a bottomless portafilter and merge into one, striking the surface where crema blooms in slow spirals and surface tension holds the foam edges. A condensation droplet gathers on the glass and slides down. Warm window backlight rims the liquid, shallow depth of field, locked-off macro at cup level.
hailuo-02.notes: Emphasise surface tension and foam edges; Hailuo renders fluid behaviour more accurately than any other model here.

gemini-omni.prompt: Create a 6-second macro shot of espresso being poured. Two thin streams leave a bottomless portafilter, merge into one, and hit the surface of a clear glass cup where crema blooms in slow spirals. A condensation droplet slides down the glass. Dark walnut counter, brushed steel machine soft in the background, warm morning window backlight rimming the crema. Locked-off camera at cup level with a slow push in. Warm filmic grade, photorealistic liquid. Audio: espresso trickle, machine hiss, one ceramic clink at the end.
gemini-omni.notes: Follow up with 'make the crema bloom slower' — Omni adjusts rather than regenerating from scratch.
